avis.texte: Cleanser itself is okay, but bottle won't close & leaks everywhere!!
This is it! I have tried it all. I have accepted that my skin is very sensitive and imperfect. This works! No pain, no redness. I dont wear face make up and I am pleased with my skin.

I really like this cleanser. Removes makeup, leaves skin feeling fresh and clean, and smells nice. I know some people aren't a fan of the fragrance, so if you're sensitive to it this may not be for you, but I like fragrance (it's similar to the fragrance for some of the face creams). I really like this.

avis.titre: Not if you are sensitive to fragrance.
avis.texte: So I have very oily skin. I used Avene thermal water when traveling so I had high hopes for this face wash. I do not recommend if your sensitive to fragrance. I keep my skincare routine regular but I rarely change products. Since this was from France I didn't think this would cause my skin to react. It made my acne flare up, something that hasn't happened to me in 6 years. The fragrance is strong if you're sensitive to strong scents. I don't recommend.

avis.titre: really good cleanser for oily skin
avis.texte: i work in a kitchen working with deep fryers and oil and grease that gets up in the air and ultimately, clings to my face and body. this cleanser does a really good job at fighting that oil and deep cleaning your pores, even after one wash it cleans really well and gets rid of that excess oil (although i always recommend double cleansing of course). the only reason i have to dock a star off of this cleanser is because it has a very obvious and sometimes over-powering fragrance, my guess is maybe because it doubles as a body cleanser?… if this cleanser wasn't as good as it is i would stop using it solely because of the scent. if you are sensitive to fragrance in your skin care products, definitely steer clear from this cleanser lol.

avis.titre: Beware if you are sensitive to fragrance
avis.texte: I have sensitive acne-probe skin and purchased this because it didn't contain any of my contact allergens (purchased online). BUT…it smells like a bottle of Axe Body Spray. I mean it's very strong. So overwhelming that I couldn't keep using it. Also had a nice little breakout from the few days I used it.
I love the way this cleanser cleans my face and make it feel so smooth!
If i could rate this cleanser 100 stars I WOULD! I tried everything and none came close to how affective at removing dirt, oil and sunscreen as this cleanser. Thank you Avène!!!

I bought this for my boyfriend, he has a bit rough/ combo skin. He has oily parts on the side of his face and around the upper cheeks. When using it, the pimples reduced its size, didnt strip his natural oils, looked smooth and hydrating! We also used it on his back and all the pimples were ready to be popped off. We love it. I also tried it and my skin is clear, supper sensitive w/ roseca, my skin felt soo clean! We used the hydrating rich cream from avene and it was amazing!

I bought this for my boyfriend, he has a bit rough/ combo skin. He has oily parts on the side of his face and around the upper cheeks. When using it, the pimples reduced its size, didnt strip his natural oils, looked smooth and hydrating! We also used it on his back and all the pimples were ready to be popped off. We love it. I also tried it and my skin is clear, supper sensitive w/ roseca, my skin felt soo clean! We used the hydrating rich cream from avene and it was amazing!

avis.titre: Great for those with oilier, acne-prone skin.
avis.texte: Little/ no irritation, the smell might be too strong for some, but is a refreshing, clean scent. Bought this while abroad and pleased to see that Ulta carries it!
Works great on my rosacea does not turn my face red or cause irritation.

I love this cleanser SO MUCH but every time I use it, I have to squeeze the bottle so tight for any product to come out and when it does, it's a lot more product than I need. I'm not sure if I got a defective bottle but the packaging cap is horrible. I wouldn't buy the 6 oz bottle again simply because of the packaging.
I'm liking it I've used other brands like La Roche and cerave, but this soap is spectacular leaves my skin soft without fat I love...
I have used this face-wash since I was a teenager and now am in my late 20's. I love it and recommend it above any other face wash!

avis.titre: Prefect cleanser for my night-time routine!
avis.texte: This cleanser isn't going to work for you if you don't already have a skincare routine. Ex: Cleansing, toning, and moisturizing. If you are not doing all the steps and think this is going to work, you'd be wrong. It would dry out your skin and leave you tight and eventually flakey. If you have a full routine, this cleanser is by far my #1 choice. It has literally changed the texture of my face. I am smooth, so smooth in fact I don't even recognize myself sometimes. I got this in a trial freebie pack, and I had results in one application. I immediately bought a larger size and it is a staple in my routine now. I highly recommend if you have a full routine and your cleanser isn't giving you smooth skin. Especially if you have oily skin with acne. 10/10!!

avis.titre: The holy grail of my skin care routine!
avis.texte: I ride or die with this product! I've been using it for years now, and it helps manage the excessive oils on my face that cause acne. Full transparancy, I also use a topical acne medicine from my dermatologist and take birth control to help control my acne. I'm an athlete, and my skin was breaking out after long workouts when my skin was covered in excessive sweat and oils for long periods. This product helps manage that. I have perfectly clear skin now! For real a game changer for controlling oil.

avis.titre: Like washing your face with perfume
avis.texte: Received as a sample. I'm not sensitive to fragrance but can't get past how heavily perfumed this product is. Combo skin - did fine as a cleanser but nothing special. It mostly felt like washing my face with a gentle hand soap. There's way better out there.
I love the clean feeling with every wash. I have very oily skin and this is great for my sckintype.
It seems like product has new edition. The old version was very comfortable to use, but the new version has a strong unpleasant smell of cheap artificial fragrance, not recommended.
This is very great product it cleans my skin without irritation, it isn't like cerave.

This cleanser is definitely for oily skin! I use it during the Summer, (warmer/humid temperatures) as this is when my face is the most oily. I have noticed a decrease in sebum production while using this cleanser. It leaves my face feeling clean and not overly dry. It smells great and I like the consistency. Only con would be at times my face can be a little sensitive to it. However, after following up with a good hydrating serum/cream, that sensitivity feeling goes away. I highly recommend to my oily skin friends !

avis.titre: Great deep penetrating and effective cleanser
avis.texte: Excellent cleanser for removing dirt and oil while simultaneously treating and preventing acne, blemishes, and clogged pores.
Best cleansing ever I love it, I have tow year using this cleansing gel it help me with my acne so I can't stop using this

I dont have a problem with the smell. I actually feel like it smells very clean. I do feel it is very drying though. I do have dry skin which this probably isnt the best face wash for me but has made me feel like it cleans my face really good. Great face wash but ive tried better.
This product is wonderful. I love the smell and it's sensitive on the skin. I highly recommend.
It works great. I think my skin got tired of my old soap, this washes off clean without drying out my skin

I am a huge fan of their rich face cream so I thought I would give this face wash a try. It has kind of a weird smell, almost like hair dye? Peoole keep saying that it is very drying, but I personally have not had that issue. It has kept my face nice and clean. I do think I would purchase again.

I am a huge fan of their rich face cream so I thought I would give this face wash a try. It has kind of a weird smell, almost like hair dye? Peoole keep saying that it is very drying, but I personally have not had that issue. It has kept my face nice and clean. I do think I would purchase again.

avis.titre: Please bring back Avene Oil-Free Gel Cleanser
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin. I tried multiple cleanser. All of them irritated my skin until I found Avene Oil-Free Gel Cleanser. That product was AMAZING. I was so happy! I tried Cleanance as the website recommended it as a replacement, however, it is causing my skin to be more and more irritated the more I use it. Please consider brining back Avene Oil-Free Gel Cleans. Thank you!

avis.titre: This is a wonderful face wash.
avis.texte: This is a wonderful face wash. I love it so much. You should try it.
I have combo skin and this cleanser really helped with my T zone.
This products has proven to leave my skin clean and smooth with no major irritation. I use it morning and night.
This really does the job to get the skin feeling clean but not stripped. I love the fresh feel and lather. It's my go to !

This is a fantastic product. Luscious lather, nice, subtle scent, leaves my skin feeling clean and glowing. I searched long and wide for a face wash until I found this product, and now I will use nothing else to clean my face.

I just couldn't get past the smell.. I found it extremely unpleasant, so much so that I had to wash my face with something else after using the cleanser. Therefore I can't really vouch for the effects of the product. As another reviewer mentioned, I felt like I could taste it, so I had to rinse out my mouth as well. It legitimately reminded me of toilet bowl cleaner. I'll have to throw it out.
Feels very cleansing in a thorough way. It has become my favorite cleanser for my highly sensitive skin.
Leaves skin impeccably clean without any sign of dryness or tightness after. Amazing product.
I really like this cleanser for removing makeup (which I rarely wear) but it's sooooo drying! It will strip your skin of everything! I wouldn't recommend for daily usage.

avis.titre: Excellent for oily skin and affordable dupe
avis.texte: I had started seeing an esthetician and she recommended the high end brand of products they carry in her office. I used them and they worked really well, but as with most high end brands comes high end prices and it was just getting a little too hard on the wallet. I found this cleanser and having used other products from this brand (also by the suggestion of my esthetician) figured I would give it a try. Even the color and consistency are a perfect dupe for the pricier gel cleanser I was using and the Avene one has kept my acne and oily skin in check just as well at a much more affordable price point.

This cleanser will always be my go-to staple! I have combination, acne-prone skin and it always leaves my skin feeling refreshed/not overly dry. A bunch of reviews mention the fragrance but I actually like it, kind of clean and floral.
Works fantastic on my sensitive skin and my skin feels amazing after use.

I have faithfully used this product for more than ten years and absolutely love it for my sensitive skin. However, the new packaging for the 6.7 oz size is problematic. The gel comes out a lot faster than the prior packaging which consisted of a plastic bottle with cap. As a result, I have gone through a whole tube in six weeks whereas the bottled packaging last me over two months. I don't want to change brands, but may have no choice since this packaging causes unreasonable waste.
Very drying for my skin and didn't seem to clear up blemishes either.

avis.titre: Best product for oily blemished skin
avis.texte: I tried the cleansing gel as I was experiencing breakouts and its amazing its helped my oily skin and breakouts in 2days. Wouldn't use anything else. Please don't discontinue this product....ever! Its amazing
I bought this after getting a sample. My skin is combination with an oilier T-zone and I find it gentle and hydrating. It also doesn't strip my skin barrier that some cleansers unfortunately will do.

Love this cleanser. I initially tried it as a sample and had to get the full size. In combination with the Retrinal Day cream, my skin has never looked better. The mattifying effect leaves my skin looking and feeling like silk.
It's was fragrance & dried out my skin after I used it. Could not use it even 2 nd time.

I received a sample ages ago and finally bough the full-size bottle. It cleans my face well without leaving a tight feeling behind and I believe it's lessened any breakouts as well. The scent is subtle and pleasant.
Burned my eyes, dried my skin but helps remove makeup. NOT for acne prone skin.

Luckily I got this in a mini size in the Avene kit. I love their products but this smells like TIDE DETERGENT! Come on, Avene. There is a large group of skincare users that are sensitive to fragrance. Why in the world would you formulate this to smell & also LOOK like laundry detergent???

I've tried tons and tons of cleansers because I like to experiment and see if I can find the next better than what I have. Let me say there are better options out there. Does it clean the face? Sure. Very strong smell, so if you're skin is very sensitive, this is not for you. Even CeraVe is better, and cheaper.

This is the best facial cleanser I've ever used!! I bought it on a whim and immediately loved it! It smells amazing, feels like a mild exfoliant. I've been using it every day for a few months now and my face looks great.
Love this cleanser. My skin feels well cleaned, but the fragrance is a distraction. I love the Avene line.

avis.titre: There's def better face washes out there
avis.texte: Felt like it wicked all my faces natural moisture away, smells not so great like chemicals or medicine not sure. I have liked many others better like fresh, Clarins, or cerave I'm still hunting for my perfect face wash.. but this ain't even in the top 10
This product could mean from such a great brand in general. Very cleansing, dryer skin hydrate well with creamer moisturizer after.
Even though I have dry skin, this is the only one cleansing gel which is clean it without overdrying. Also, it's strong enough to wash away any make up leftovers.
awful, my acne prone skin never burned so bad. had a really nasty reaction and i am not allergic to anything but whatever is in this burns and hurts my skin so bad.
This product is good because it doesn't dry out my skin, nor is it oily. I have used this for years now and have had clear skin for nearly as long.
After years I've finally found the one! I see a seen an immense improvement in my skin, from fine lines and wrinkles to acne. Don't delay. Purchase now!
I love it. My skin feels clean & fresh not tight. Been using it for a while now and am very happy as always. Thx you for a great product!!

I ABSOLUTELY love it‼ it leaves my skin as clean as I'm sure it was when I was a baby 56 years ago,lol my skin is ALWAYS glowing with all AVENE products but this is the product where it all starts. Thank you Avene ❤⚘

avis.titre: Overall I'm pretty happy with this product!
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser for a few months and it's definitely helped with oiliness and some irritation. I love the consistency and the foaming, my skin feels clean without being stripped.

I like this face wash! It's foams up really nice and my face feels really clean afterwards. Probably not the best for dry skin because it kind of strips your skin, I don't mind that because I am extremely oily. Also, the fragrance is a bit much. So if ur a fragrance-free type of person I wouldn't get this. But honestly I'd buy again

I like this face wash! It's foams up really nice and my face feels really clean afterwards. Probably not the best for dry skin because it kind of strips your skin, I don't mind that because I am extremely oily. Also, the fragrance is a bit much. So if ur a fragrance-free type of person I wouldn't get this. But honestly I'd buy again

avis.titre: My skin looks incredible after using this!
avis.texte: Revived a sample of this with another purchase and I'm genuinely shocked how good it is! I immediately went to purchase the full size. My skin looks so healthy after using this!

I love the wash. It's gentle on skin & love the smell. I used to use shower gel or whatever I had but the soap was drying out my skin BAD. I have extremely dry skin as is. I've been like that my whole life.
I have very dry sensitive skin in the Humid months of Texas and this has helped my skin so much from further cracking!! Very light fragrance and not too soapy on my skin!
Love it...I used it for my face every night and is super refreshing and a delicate fragrance.

I absolutely love every single Avene product. I tried this face wash as a sample and fell in love, I ordered the biggest size bottle, it smells amazing and makes my skin feel clean and nourished. Recommend Avene to everyone!

I've been using this product since 2020 til now its way better than using ordinary soap or other facial cleanser. I fell my face is so clean and feel refresh everytime i use it. Definitely will order again and highly recommeded esp for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Really helping to clear up my acne!
avis.texte: I love the Avene brand! I use the Cleanance line. I use the serum and the Matte moisturizer and have just added this cleanser and I notice a big difference in my skin. The cleanser is not drying or irritating and I do have sensitive skin. I was concerned about the fragrance as some have mentioned but it is not a problem for me. I do remove my makeup first with vanicream gentle cleanser. I will definitely repurchase this cleanser.
This product washes all the impurities and removes oils and makeup. I also love how the scent isnt strong
This cleansing gel cleared up my cystic acne and minimized my pores. My skin looks better than it has in years.

As far as I've been cleaning my face with this product, the results are very satisfying. Ideal for sensitive skin, and specially, for acne around chin, ears, and neck (product of breast-feeding my baby). Excellent product.

Love this face wash. I have acne prone combination skin and I've searched and searched for something that works. After repeated use and the regime of some of Avene's other products my skin is the best it has been in a long time. It removes excess makeup and dirt and leaves my pores feeling clean.
Works great to remove makeup without over drying and provides a foamy lather when used in the shower.

I really enjoyed this cleansing gel. My face felt so clean and healthy after using it. It didn't dry my face or make it oily. Which I truly appreciate. I didn't feel any leftover residue on my skin or anything.
Its a fresh, clean feeling. You don't have the residue that some leave

avis.titre: 6 months of use, best skin of my life!
avis.texte: I'm 31 and still dealing with acne. Or at least, I was until 6 months ago when I started using this cleanser. I've always gone with face washes that have salicylic acid any things like that but I just kept breaking out, my skin texture was just never great. Then my dermatologist recommended a switch to a gentle cleanser twice a day, followed by my standard routine (vitamin c serum with caffeine and moisturizer in the morning then retinal, eye cream, moisturizer at night). I picked this up and didn't change anything else. My skin LOVES IT!!! I haven't had a break out in about 5 months and my skin texture is so smooth and soft. I'm so happy with this cleanser, I just love it

This cleansing gel is the best I've used for my oily, sensitive acne prone skin.I have no words it makes my skin feel so clean and soft without drying it. My skin looks better when using it. Apparently they reformulated this but it's still so perfect. I hope Avene won't change the formula again bc it's already so perfect. Please don't change the formula again/discontinue bc It's already the perfect product/formula and the PH level is 5.5 its rly amazing. Thank you Avène for making this.
The best facial cleanser I've tried! It reduces the visible pores on my face. Removes dirt and gives me radiant results.
I like the cleanser. There is a scent if you don't like that. I have a little larger bottle and I feel too much is dispensed each time. Otherwise I don't find it irritating.
It has really helped in getting rid of my acne and I like that it does not dry out my skin :)

I've really enjoyed using the Avène Gel Cleanser! The color itself is unique compared to any other cleanser I've used (I love the blue!) and it leaves your skin feeling amazing afterwards. I've used many different cleansers and gel is definitely my favorite, so I'd 100% buy this product again. I love the feeling of it in your hands and it lathers well on your face without leaving a sticky residue. My face feels great afterwards and it does well at stripping the oil and grime, even on my oily skin! The only reason I gave this product 4 stars is because the scent isn't very appealing and it's intense! I normally don't mind products with fragrance but this one is completely overwhelming and makes me sneeze every use. If you're sensitive to fragrance than I don't recommend this cleanser. Despite that, I would still suggest this cleanser if you enjoy gel consistency or want to try something new. As mentioned, I would definitely use it again. In reference to the picture attached, this product is clearly not an acne cleanser but it does great at cleaning your face efficiently and making your skin feel soft.
I used the cleaner for almost 1 year and this is the best, in my opinion.
This cleanser was great addition to a morning skincare routine. It helps reduce redness and oily skin. It prevents oils on your face and keeps your makeup looking fresh for longer.
I've never been a huge fan on gel cleansers however I do happen to actually like this one a lot makes my skin feel nice and it is good for oily and blemish prone skin which I have love it
The gel was so smooth on my face and very easy to use. I loved it. It helps with my oily skin and purifies it. I would totally recommend this to my friends or family.
I enjoyed using this cleanser as I was hesitant at the beginning due to my sensitive skin. It did not disappoint
I love it. Quick and simple. Not only does it leave my face clean and healthy but I've used as a quick makeup remover. Works every time!
This cleanser leaves me feeling squeaky clean and fresh! Smells really good and doesn't leave my face dry. Very happy I got the sample size and definitely going to be buying the full size bottle.
I would buy this again for sure! Formula goes on so nicely, has a great sense, it's not harsh, but purifies completely! A little goes a long way as it lathers up so nice and bubbly!
I could not properly review this product due to i used it once and was having a reaction to the product.
I did not particularly like the scent. It cleans your face, doesn't dry it out either

It's a nice scent, but it's too strong. As a cleanser, it cleansed nice. It goes from a gel to a white, soapy consistency. It works well at mattifying and cleansing. I wouldn't recommend this because the scent is too strong, but if you're okay with that, it's worth a try if you like mattifying cleansers.
This cleansing gel is amazing! It isn't too harsh, and really cleans my pores!
This cleanser is amazing! It makes my face feel wonderful after just a few simple uses.
This cleanser applies smoothly and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. I am definitely going to be purchasing more of this product and would definitely recommend it

Tengo usando este gel tres años y no lo cambio por nada, porque me ha privado súper bien con el tema de mi acné, pero tengo la piel combinada y está no me reseca la otra parte que no tiene acné. Y ya hasta mi Adolecente también lo usa, siempre compro para mi y para ella. Me encanta toda la línea Avene
I loved this cleansing gel. It was super refreshing. It made my skin fell soft and smooth.
This product worked well to cleanse my skin. It does have a stronger scent than I would like, but I don't think it irritated my skin. The texture is a smooth, thin gel.

This Avene Cleanance Cleansing Gel is a great everyday cleanser. It is gentle on my skin, safe to use during my current pregnancy, and leaves my face feeling clean all day! The formula in this product really does seem to help reduce the appearance of blemishes and I believe it will get even better with time as well. Overall, this is a great gentle everyday cleanser to add to your routine!

The cleanser is heavily fragranced, so if you have sensitive skin, I don't recommend. This cleanser is also not very sudsy, but does dry/mattify skin, so I don't recommend for people with dry skin either. This works OK as a second cleanser in my skincare routine but doesn't really cleanse the first step off well unless I use a ton of product. If you have a simple skincare routine or don't wear makeup, I'd suggest this.

I think that this is a great cleanser for people who like gel cleanser. I usually wash my face twice normally, but with this cleanser, I felt like I needed to. There was not a lot of sudding with the cleanser. My skin sucked up the cleanser, so I always needed more than a normal amount.
remove all makeup. wow this is amazing. I think he is my favourite. leaves my skin so soft and fresh

I received a free trial size and have been using as an everyday cleanser, usually in the mornings. It has a nice, light scent and a good gel consistency - not too runny or thick. It took a few days for my sensitive skin to adjust because I felt slightly more oily and red in the beginning, but now my skin appears healthier. Will consider purchasing in the future.

I received this product in exchange to an honest review. I used the trial size until it was gone and I really like it. My skin feels really clean and the product smells really good (which might be a negative thing if you have sensitive skin). I repurchased it and will continue to do so. It'sa great addition to my routine.

Overall I was satisfied with the product. I received a small sample so I couldn't give you a full review of the affects of the skin and cleansing gel over time. My face did feel clean after using and didn't cause breakouts.

I loved how this cleansing gel felt on my face, and it was gentle enough to use with my sensitive skin. I really loved how the gel lathered up, but the only negative was that I felt the scent was a bit overpowering. I actually like the scent so I don't mind it too much, but I can see how it might bother someone who is used to fragrance-free products.

avis.titre: gentle and good for all skin types
avis.texte: I actually really enjoyed this cleanser. it's a gel formula but not drying so great for all skin types. I have combination skin and this was really nice in that it did not strip the oil from my skin and make my skin feel tight but also didn't feel too heavy where I would produce more oil. I felt like after cleaning my face, my skin felt balanced and I didnt need to rush to put on moisturizer. I definitely feel like it would be a good cleanser in the summer times. The product itself is a more runny gel formula and it creates a very mild lather. It's also scented with a somewhat soft, almost powdery floral scent. I wish the scent was a little more mild, but that's just me personally. I would say that it's a good basic cleanser, but not really meant for deep cleansing. I felt like if I used this to remove residual makeup, I would find that there are hints of makeup still lingering around, so I would prefer to use this as a basic cleanser. But overall, I really enjoyed this.
Smells really nice. A nice light fragrance not too harsh, and the gel removed makeup like butter! I have sensitive skin so no irritation which is a bonus!
This cleanser applies beautifully and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. I am definitely going to be purchasing more of this!
